name: Google Ads weekly account keeper
why: Runs the weekly routine from your exports: waste cut, a scale-or-hold call and a change list to approve.

name: Search term junk sorter
why: Turns a search terms report into winners to promote and negatives to add, the core of the weekly clean-up.

name: Search term sorter
why: A deeper search terms pass that also says where each negative should go.

name: Google Ads purchase tracking checker
why: Checks your conversion actions for double counting before you trust any bidding decision.

name: Google bid strategy chooser
why: Picks a bid strategy and target from your campaign results, to pair with the Smart Bidding skill.

name: Brand and non-brand splitter
why: Finds brand traffic leaking into other campaigns and shows your true non-brand return.

name: Google Ads store account auditor
why: A scored audit for online shops with a 90-day fix order.

name: Performance Max routine keeper
why: Weekly Performance Max checks: exclusions, budget moves and where the spend goes.

name: Performance Max launch planner
why: Decides whether Performance Max fits your catalogue and budget, then plans the build.

name: Merchant Center feed health checker
why: Ranks feed problems by lost sales, because the feed decides which searches your products can show for.

name: Shopping feed title writer
why: Rewrites product titles around the words people search, one of the biggest Shopping levers.

name: Google Ads dip investigator
why: Finds the likely cause when results drop and says whether to fix or wait.

name: Break-even ROAS and CPA calculator
why: Works out the most you can pay per sale, the number every target is set against.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: A monthly check across analytics and ad platforms that catches broken tracking and double counts.
